summary: Ran a fresh isolated Google Chrome session at 1440 px and inspected all 14 page-owned controls. Ten safe same-origin GET links were clicked independently: the blog return link plus image/title/CTA links for all three related cards; every click reached its exact href with no error. The four sourced external product links were visible, enabled, retained target=_blank and matched the frozen WYSIWYG URLs; they were deliberately not opened. No forms, commerce actions, messages, account actions or state-changing requests were performed.
